headline: GO084 turns the rootfs-run persistence finding into a bounded Layer-3 persistence contract without moving live state or conflating legacy voice databases with canonical UnifiedDB
state: Live andreas-maco evidence proves ENTITYOS_ROOTFS_RUN is intentionally recreated and removed by entityos-vm.service, while durable state is expected to live on explicit binds. The running clone currently contains state-bearing SQLite files below /root/.local/share that are not covered by a durable bind. Source inspection shows consciousness.db is directly consumed by multiple voice/inner-world paths; world_experience.db carries personality_state/identity_snapshots/extreme_state_log; amygdala.db carries extinction_patterns/somatic_markers/threat_log; the clone-local agentzero/unified.db carries dopamine_state/reward_log and is referenced by voice modules. No nonempty host counterpart exists for these exact legacy paths. The canonical /var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db is a distinct large durable store and MUST NOT be silently merged with the clone-local voice unified.db. The ONNX runtime DB remains CACHE_DERIVED_CANDIDATE pending stronger evidence and is excluded from the durable-state contract.

contract.immutable_rule: KEEP_ROOTFS_RUN_WIPE; persistence is solved by Layer-3 bindings, never by weakening reproducible rootfs recreation
contract.path_identity_rule: Preserve the existing in-container paths seen by Path.home()/expanduser callers; only the backing storage changes
contract.canonical_unifieddb_fence: Do not alias, replace, attach, or merge /root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db with /var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db without a separate schema/identity migration workpackage and executable readback
contract.cache_fence: Do not persist .cache/Microsoft/DeveloperTools/.onnxruntime/onnxruntime.db merely because it contains rows

migration_discriminator: Before any mutation, bind exact source paths, table sets, SQLite quick_check, row-count/vector, active writer set and current VM subject.
Quiesce only the exact writers through their admitted lifecycle path; do not restart/wipe rootfs-run before a coherent SQLite backup exists.
Create durable backups with SQLite backup semantics, not raw copying of potentially live WAL state.
Install only the two narrow Layer-3 bind roots above; keep canonical /var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db untouched.
Recreate rootfs-run through the existing normal VM lifecycle so the destructive wipe is actually exercised.
Read back the same logical tables/rows through the unchanged in-container paths and verify SQLite integrity plus voice/inner-world startup.
Write one new marker through each durable state family, recreate rootfs-run again, and prove the markers survive from the bound durable backing.
Any schema mismatch, path-identity drift, missing row family, wrong canonical UnifiedDB target, or writer ambiguity is fail-closed and yields zero persistence promotion.
authority_fence: This artifact is a design/evidence closure only. It does not authorize automatic rescue, DB movement, VM restart, gate closure or effect execution. The live-state move remains effect-bearing work requiring current owner/effect authority.
zero_credit: no new physical GRID10 runtime credit
next: Obtain current effect/owner authority for the live-state migration or keep the exact migration discriminator staged. Independently preserve the natural GO083 watcher transition and the post-quota architect recovery when they occur; do not manufacture either event.
